time_unit: dimensionless developmental step; not a calendar day

architecture.main_apex_history: Retained dominant main axis; approximate photo centerlines at index 100
architecture.source: reference.json centerlines; per-organ leaf priors in build.py

event.selection: Fixed leaf IDs only for continuity comparison; not a horticultural recommendation
event.status: Constructed comparison event; not measured grower history or a cutting simulation

status.geometry: Approximate single-view photo centerlines with explicitly assumed depth, tissue properties and developmental timing
status.mechanics: Per-organ mass and beam rigidity exported with assumed material values. Whole-plant contact is not solved.
status.growth: Organ birth and age-dependent expansion; no carbon, water, hormone or light-response solver
status.variation: A is photo-constrained; B/C are uncertainty variants of depth and organ pose, not a calibrated cultivar population
status.flowers: Simplified external envelopes, not calibrated inflorescence development
